title: Gafgyt_Botnet_Investigation_8ba
description: Investigate and mitigate the Gafgyt botnet activity within the sandbox environment.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and performance degradation. Your task is to investigate and identify the source of these issues. Learning objective: Understand the basics of botnet investigation and the tools required to identify and mitigate botnet activity.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano. Enter the word 'start' to proceed to the next level.
levels.local_content: You have SSH access to the bot1 host with the following credentials: Username: cyrano, Password: cyrano. Enter the word 'start' to proceed to the next level.

levels.title: Investigate Suspicious Services
levels.content: Investigate the system for unauthorized or suspicious services that might be responsible for periodic external communication. Identify the service name flag.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and system logs for unusual network activity. Use the command `systemctl list-units --type=service`.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for the service named `bot-flood-busybox.service`. Use the command `systemctl status bot-flood-busybox.service`.

levels.title: Identify Command-and-Control Server
levels.content: Determine the external host that the compromised system is communicating with. Identify the C2 server IP address flag.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine network connections and logs to identify the command-and-control server. Use the command `grep -i 'c2-server' /var/lib/.botcache/beacon.log`.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the beacon logs for the C2 server IP address. Use the command `cat /var/lib/.botcache/beacon.log | grep -i 'c2-server'`.

levels.title: Identify Flooding Target
levels.content: Identify the system receiving the abnormal volume of network traffic generated by the compromised host. Identify the target IP address flag.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Analyze network flows to determine the victim of the flooding activity. Use the command `grep -i 'flood_target_host' /usr/local/lib/.botcache/flood.sh`.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check the flood logs for the target IP address. Use the command `cat /usr/local/lib/.botcache/flood.sh | grep -i 'flood_target_host'`.
